newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Van Miert to propose banning Cablevision.
newsitem.headline: Van Miert to propose banning Cablevision.

text.p: European Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert is to propose that the European Commission block Cablevision, the Spanish cable television deal between Telefonica de Espana and Canal Plus, a European Union source said.
"He will propose to his colleagues to ban the merger" the source said on Wednesday.

The EU's consultative committee on concentrations concluded earlier this week that the joint venture should be blocked on the grounds it would create a dominant position in the Spanish market. Spain was the only dissenting voice on the committee.
The Commission must take a final decision on the operation by November 26. However, it could be spared the ruling if the parent companies took the initiative and withdrew the deal.
Commission sources said earlier this week that Telefonica may do that to avoid a negative ruling.

But Sogecable, its partner in the venture which belongs to Canal Plus France and Spain's Promotora de Informaciones SA, was more reluctant to abandon the plan, the sources said, speculating that it might seek compensation from Telefonica.
